_meta.notes: Per-archetype tailoring playbooks for rewriting a student's EXISTING CV content toward a role type (UK undergraduate internships, placements, insight programmes). Every field is guidance for reordering, emphasis and equivalent-term substitution only: never add facts, numbers, tools, employers or escalate authorship (used < built < led). A reframe applies only when its onlyIf condition is met by the source line; bracketed slots must be filled from the source or dropped. Grades: A = employer guidance plus a top-tier UK careers source, or several agree; B = one top-tier UK careers publisher, Russell Group careers service or professional body, or two lesser sources; C = single practitioner/employer-blog/recruitment-agency source; D = synthesis. Quotes are verbatim (<=25 words) from pages fetched 2026-10-14, checked by script against the fetched text. Product is the thinnest evidence base (no UK careers guide specific to PM CVs found). Companion: role-playbooks-tech-product.json (R-ids) and cv-rules-tech-product.md (S-ids); several TP sources are the same pages (TP1=R2/S3, TP2=S5, TP4=R59, TP6=R7, TP7=R8, TP8=R9, TP9=R10, TP10=R11, TP11=R12, TP12=R13, TP13=R14, TP16=R21).
